interpretation: Optimization, evaluation and buffer-selection costs are cumulative across completed selected checkpoints. They do not exhaust process or allocated walltime.
Runner attempt duration and Slurm allocated duration measure overlapping intervals of the same attempt. Choose one measure; do not add them.

Slurm allocated seconds sum across jobs is resource-allocation duration, not calendar elapsed time or measured GPU-busy time. Jobs requested one GPU each; GPU utilization time series is unavailable, not zero.
Intentional cancelled attempts are separate resource costs, not unsuccessful scientific outcomes to retry.
Local creation-to-log intervals are timestamp-derived, not process-exit walltime; local exit codes are unobserved.
No combined end-to-end local-plus-HPC walltime is asserted; local tabular attempt overhead and brief aborted CIC17 startup are unmeasured.
This artifact covers formal training attempts, not smoke tests, data preparation, downstream analysis, or literature-search time.
